verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scoping users/tenants to container tags and deleting all that container's content via API/console to satisfy a deletion request (per-entity and full erasure), and document-operations.md confirms delete support for ingested documents. However, no evidence explicitly documents a single-memory-level delete endpoint (only document delete and container-tag delete are named), and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation that deletion is complete and irreversible. Missing for 10: explicit single-memory deletion API/endpoint documentation, independent verification that erasure is thorough (e.g., audit or hands-on test).
